segments.text: >> Welcome to what's new in the Payables agent in Business Central in the 2026 release wave one. In this video, we'll cover these cool additions we've been working on for this release.

We're super excited about this. Let's get started. The Payables agent now supports one-to-one matching between invoice lines and purchase order lines. It uses AI to interpret line descriptions and find the best match among your open purchase orders.
When a match is found, the agent checks if the received quantity is sufficient for invoicing and highlights a warning if it's not. Receipt must still be done manually for now.

A cornerstone page finance teams must know about is the inbound e-documents list. This is where new draft invoices land, and it now includes more information to support these teams, giving them an option to navigate to the agent tasks for the specific invoice.
Also, to support finance teams working in the same mailbox as the agent, they can now see which emails have been processed and avoid the risk of duplicate work.
Let's talk about cost. The agent is free to try up to a certain number of invoices. After that, you pay based on volume using Copilot credits. Here's how it works.
50 credits for the invoice document plus five credits per invoice line. So, a five-line invoice costs 75 credits. At roughly 1 US cent per credit, that's about 75 cents per invoice.
Try using analysis assist on the posted purchase invoice lines page to find the invoice volume and the average number of purchase invoice lines your company.

This will help you calculate the projected cost of using the agent. The Payables agent should be even easier to discover. We are making it much easier to try out the agent via the agent configuration page, but we are also surfacing the agent in familiar places like the purchase invoice page and purchase invoice list.
These allow accounts payable users to try out the agent for free and process a single invoice they upload without needing to set up a shared mailbox or fully activate the agent first.

We're excited to announce that the Payables agent is now available in all the countries and regions where Business Central is available and is supported in all the languages we as Microsoft provide as part of our localizations.

We'd love your feedback on the Payables agent so we can make it even better. Submit it directly from the purchase document draft page using the provide feedback action. You can include context about the current invoice and follow our replies on the feedback portal.
Find the feedback portal at feedbackportal.microsoft.com and make sure to view my feedback. That's it for the news about the Payables agent in this release wave.

Notice that some of these features may not necessarily be part of the major release, but will be available in an upcoming minor release. Now, over to Soren, our product manager for the Payables agent.
On behalf of the Payables agent team, thank you for watching this video. Please keep the feedback coming so we can keep improving on the agent. Thank you for watching.
Hey, before you go, we want to make sure you know about our YouTube channel, your one-stop shop for skilling up on Business Central. Bookmark it now if you haven't already.
